interpretation.native: Actual archived emulator fills, equal fees and fixed additional spread sensitivity; exchange fills and mark-to-market equity are unavailable.
interpretation.ohlc: Same causal READY tape. Next available open with adverse ticks; known open crosses precede stop-first unordered touches; 3 equal target parts; protection becomes effective next bar.
interpretation.session: RC2 display's fixed UTC bands, assigned at the actual or modeled entry timestamp.
interpretation.mae_mfe: Quote-unit excursion from actual or modeled fill, observed parts and full interior candles. Entry and final exit bar extrema are excluded.
interpretation.missed_moves: Post-close qualifying UTC hours and forward ranges are diagnostic price observations. They provide no evidence that a missed position would have made money.
interpretation.partitions: Both chronological archive partitions were already inspected. No promotion inference or selection based on this archive.

chronological_archive.rule: first 60% of bars then 40%; cross-boundary campaigns retained only in full sample
